data: In Google Billion Word plot, which activation mechanism shows the highest perplexity at 100 hours?

The question asks about the activation mechanism showing the highest perplexity at 100 hours in the Google Billion Word plot. From the caption, we know that the ReLU activation mechanism is shown in blue, GTU in orange, and GLU in red. In the right graph, the lines representing these activation mechanisms are visible. At 100 hours, the ReLU line is the highest among the three, indicating the highest perplexity. Therefore, the ReLU activation mechanism shows the highest perplexity at 100 hours in the Google Billion Word plot.
